title: OpenQuestion
description: Mostly deterministic, and that is the point. The lowest-risk, cheapest high-value output in the product (D-026). data/schema.md §1.8.

supporting_citations.description: OPTIONAL, unlike Fact.citations. An OpenQuestion about an ABSENT document has nothing to cite. This is the one place the drop-if-uncitable rule cannot apply, and it is precisely why OpenQuestion cannot be a Fact with a status (D-027).
